public.aboutMissionText: The Geo Wushu Competition System helps organisers run wushu and sanda tournaments efficiently. From registration and weigh-in to brackets, scheduling, and live results — everything in one place.
public.aboutWhatItDoesText: Coaches register athletes into events. Organisers run weigh-in, execute the draw, and publish brackets. Spectators and participants see live schedule and results. No Excel, no "which fight now?" — just a reliable, auditable system.
public.aboutContactText: For questions about events or the system, reach out to your event organiser.
public.rulesIntro: This page describes the event lifecycle and how content becomes visible to the public.
public.rulesStep1: Registration open — coaches register athletes into categories.
public.rulesStep2: Weigh-in — athletes are weighed; overweight athletes get a one-hour window to make weight.
public.rulesStep3: Registration locked — no more changes; draw is ready to run.
public.rulesStep5: Brackets published — public can see brackets, schedule, and results.
public.rulesStep6: Competition live — fights run; results update in real time.
public.rulesPublishingText: Brackets, schedule, and results are only visible to the public after the organiser publishes them. Until then, these pages show "Not published yet". This ensures spectators and participants see accurate, finalised information.
